positives: Commit V3 after scheduling V2; retain the V2 binding, record V3 and the reason, with no build.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original deleted result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original edited result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original run result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Use one valid Project scenario with resolved config, validated service/profile/env references and the original saved result; no other scenario changes.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.

single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Read one genuine created schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Read one genuine invalidated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.
A genuine target-already-invalidated result preserves the exact original nonempty reason text without narrowing or translating its domain.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.

single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: Read one genuine updated schedule result with the exact target and original source edition, preserving grace and occurrence identity.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: A host evaluates an unfinished Goal with a genuine next attempt and unchanged epoch; also plan an independently valid complete case backed by caller evidence.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Original application edition with null Project and CV-366 exact application key.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-GOAL-THREAD-LIFETIME is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

families.special_rules: One host evaluation at a continuation boundary records continue/complete/pause/blocked/cancelled, the exact Goal revision, owning run, next attempt and observed user_stop_epoch. Continue requires unfinished objective, eligible thread, runnable attempt and unchanged Stop epoch again at dispatch; complete requires genuine caller-owned completion evidence. This event neither schedules a second turn nor mutates Goal body. Use the existing idempotency tuple (goal_id, goal_revision, owning_run_id, next_attempt_ref), with canonical explicit null for no next attempt; a reevaluation is a distinct original decision only when a genuine owner-state change changes that existing tuple; the same tuple always resolves its one original under GRS-050, never a reminted effect ID.
families.coverage_rule: Every publication shape field, original envelope/receipt join, SP-337 route/id/size/media/durability/limit gate, canonical cleanup dependency and all 16 publication-state pairs is planned below. Preserve original payload/family guards. Phase 2 derives the final complete assertion-site inventory from actual schema/checker, splits remaining multi-form variants, and proves each predicate with the reviewed shared tool; no phase-1 execution claim.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original archived result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

Frozen original is unchanged. Settled cleanup additionally requires exact canonical policy eligibility and every pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup release; indefinite policies do not age-expire.
publication_transition_matrix.expected_effects: Only the permitted journal edge, or no write/effect on same-state resolution; no repeated owner effect.

single_defect_layers.schema: A selected definition shape gate before joins; no stale observational copies are inputs.
single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
single_defect_layers.transitions: Destination shape and custody valid; only predecessor→successor legality fails.
single_defect_layers.proof: Phase 2 shared tool only; plans and static shape probes are not proof.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original child_refs_changed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original created result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

families.phase2_shared_tool_rule: Phase 2: reviewed shared pm_guard_isolation.py; predicate-specific cut, unrelated peers enabled. Same-field/same-predicate duplicates are proved site by site and all sites together. No phase-1 execution or isolation proof.
families.schema_predicate_cut_rule: Inventory every same-field predicate at each schema site. A length bound also embedded in a pattern is cut at that bound only, with character predicates preserved; a type implied by enum/const is the corresponding primitive-domain clause. Removing the entire keyword or merging unrelated predicates proves nothing. Each negative_variants member is an independent one-defect case, never combined with another variant.

positives: One exact Project+NamedPlan original priority_changed result with unchanged child runtime; duplicate display names in the Project are independently valid.
Exact retry after lost acknowledgement returns original complete event and first receipt, no second effect.
Valid retained original after later live-state/revision/route change; current writer guards are not called.
Valid retained compatibility/replay-only record only where authenticated original admission and recipe genuinely permit it; no current append.
SP-278 matching Storage identities and complete token, verified empty versus nonempty zero-match range distinguished.
Existing owner numeric domains including Storage u64 boundary via shared helper; representable and refused producer-JCS routes follow shared owner, not lane caps.
Project-only case rejects application without changing Project source semantics.

Materialize this exact publication schema with a small inline logical event, null payload_ref, canonical encoded Project partition and independently issued original source. For an authorized application edition repeat with app, null Project and the exact CV-366 key; Project-only families get no application positive.

Materialize this exact publication schema with null inline payload and a real SP-337 descriptor: payload:v1 BLAKE3 route, matching 64-character id, exact uncompressed SP-236 byte_size and application/msgpack media. Authenticate actual pack/index, resolve the complete logical event, validate unchanged EventRecord plus this family payload, and verify actual original CV-339 full-value commitment. Repeat prepared, appended and settled.

Boundary positives: the EventRecord body inline ceiling accepts exactly 16,384 encoded bytes; above it requires SP-337. The complete redb publication has its separate 16,384-byte ceiling, so even an at-boundary body is referenced when its wrapper would overflow. Materialize a 16,385-byte valid resolved body externally and an exactly-at-limit complete journal; no truncation or guessed numeric cap.

Commit original owner result and prepared publication atomically; prepared has independent null first_append_receipt and null full_value_commitment. Then obtain the actual first all-member receipt and complete original commitment, CAS prepared→appended, and only after the original accepted result and receipt are ready CAS appended→settled and acknowledge.

Crash cuts: before atomic owner/journal commit leaves neither; after prepared commit retains owner effect plus pending journal; after pack sync before journal leaves only reclaimable unreferenced bytes; after actual durable append before prepared→appended CAS resolves the same original; after appended before settled and after settled before lost acknowledgement return the original without another effect, ID, time, producer sequence, receipt or charge.

Restart a prepared original before first issuance with null receipt/commitment: inspect original source/pending custody and require ordinary initial-append admission before first issuance; do not fabricate a receipt. If durable append already occurred before the prepared→appended CAS, use the actual full-value original resolver. Appended/settled restarts return that same original. Restore the coherent source/journal/packs/seglog/receipt/tombstone/Stop/index closure; an older restore cannot remint missing original work.

Withdraw the exact writer under append lock separately with prepared, appended and settled originals: preserve unresolved custody, stop new prepares and pending drains, allow only separately authorized read-only original lookup. Withdraw the reader independently: interpretation stops without deleting original custody. A new reviewed explicit adoption alone can re-enable; historical original admission/recipe never acts as a current writer grant.

Read an authentic retained original after live revision/object/route change with current read permission, original admission/recipe and actual custody intact. A deleted referenced body is unavailable rather than reconstructed. Reader withdrawal and deletion visibility are still enforced.

Canonical retention: keep original pending/result/receipt/recovery/live-reference/hold/backup closure; only eligible settled cleanup under RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE is legal. Derived-index rebuild never recreates this journal. For G20 integrate the approved policy object first; event and journal are one counted fact, linked rollover keeps the complete closure.

Delete only a described object or linked chat/body while retaining this permanent metadata event under its original Project/app-root policy. History remains readable with current permission; missing linked content is disclosed unavailable. Only genuine owning-data deletion tombstones the event itself.

single_defect_layers.reference: Descriptor/pack-byte gate before decode and logical source joins.
single_defect_layers.runtime: Schema-valid candidate, authentic independently issued originals, coherent non-target copies/keys/commitments/post-state. Predicate-local failures are separate even if refusal codes coincide.
